title: Asset register & check-out
summary: A register of loanable equipment with a check-out form, a due-back return task with a reminder, and Returned / Damaged outcomes that update the register.
description:
Asset register & check-out replaces the clipboard by the equipment cupboard. The Assets table is your register: tag, name, category, home location, serial number, condition, replacement value and whether each item is available, out or in repair. Sample rows cover loan laptops, AV kit, a camera, tools, a pool car and safety equipment.

People borrow from the Asset check-out form page. They search for the asset (only available items are offered) and its category, location and condition fill in by themselves; they pick the borrower as a Person, set the due-back date and accept responsibility. Check out shows a success screen.

The Form submitted trigger starts the workflow: it double-checks the asset is still available, marks it checked out in the register, logs the loan in the Check-outs table and emails the borrower a receipt. The borrower then gets a Return task due on the due-back date, with a reminder the day before. Returned puts the asset back in the register with its new condition; Damaged sends it for repair and records what went wrong. A two-year retention policy is included for the loan records. No integrations needed.
start: Starts from a form page: open the Asset check-out form (/f/<id>) at the equipment cupboard or share its link; each check-out starts the workflow.
setup: Nothing to configure: install it and open the Asset check-out form from Forms (or share its /f/ link, or print a QR code for the cupboard).
Replace the sample rows in the Assets table with your register (or import a CSV). Keep Status as available for items that can be borrowed.
Optional: apply the "Check-outs: 2 years" retention policy to the Check-outs table, and set EMAIL_PROVIDER so receipts are delivered (the console provider logs them).

steps.title: Pick the asset
steps.body: On the check-out form the borrower searches the register; category, location and condition fill in from the Assets table.

steps.title: Who and until when
steps.body: The borrower is picked as a Person, with a due-back date and a purpose; Check out shows a success screen.

steps.title: Register and log
steps.body: The workflow confirms the asset is still available, marks it checked out and logs the loan in Check-outs.

steps.title: Receipt
steps.body: The borrower gets an email receipt with the due date and where to return it.

steps.title: Return task with a reminder
steps.body: A return task is due on the due-back date and reminds the borrower a day before.

steps.title: Returned or Damaged
steps.body: Returned makes the asset available again with its new condition; Damaged sends it for repair and records the damage.
